problem.title: Smallest Missing Integer Greater Than Sequential Prefix Sum

approaches.title: Sequential prefix sum with bounded presence tracking
approaches.summary: Finds the longest sequential prefix, computes its sum, records values present in the remaining suffix, and scans a fixed bounded range for the smallest missing integer greater than the sum.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial implementation using sequential-prefix detection, a fixed presence array, and a suffix scan. It contains an underflow risk from computing left - 1 when the prefix reaches the end.

revisions.commitBody:
underflow would only cause issues in debug mode as the skip happens
correctly for any usize when rest.len() is 0
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the potentially underflowing left - 1 with saturating_sub(1) and moves the suffix scan after the sum bound check, preserving the same algorithm.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2996: fix init bug that casuses rescan when whole array is squential
revisions.commitBody: - remove redundent increment and decrement of left
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initializes left to rest.len() and uses the break index directly, removing redundant index adjustments and correctly handling an entirely sequential array.
